Name: The Shack - Seeds Bags
Author: UsoliaNaviento
Description:
[center][b]This is my second mods, another retexture packs!



I know i'm not the first one to do this, but i wanted to create a mod that will change the sprites of the seeds for a lots of the mods that i have, but didn't have the same look. I love (I NEED! T^T) consistency, so I decide to do it myself!

[/b][img]https://i.ibb.co/DP62pDSk/S-parateur.png[/img]

I create a pattern of seed pack and i add a little colored tab for each mods (inspired by the color i can find in the original mod). For now, i only created a single color pack, but when i will find the good idea/design, i think i will do a seasonned version. But all my test look like crap, so for now, single color is good.


Right now, only the the seeds from the base game are cover. But my plan is to do this for all the mods i uses... And all the mods you will ask!
[b]

Right now, i will add mods sprites from time to time.  Of course, feel free to ask for specific mods! Maybe i didn't have the mods you wanted, or it's low on my to do list right now. (Idem if you saw an error, or if for you, the color choice for the packs are a little off... Don't be afraid!)

Edit 17/10/2025 : It's done. I completed all the mod i wanted! (Except Raffadax, but i wait for the big update). I will post soon a "One for all", with all the files insides, but right now, i will work on the requested mod!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/DP62pDSk/S-parateur.png[/img]

Edit 11/11/2025 : Hey guys! I do a little update of the mod, i add the fruit trees! Sorry that i didn't did it sooner.

Because right now, i cover like... Almost 50 others mods, i decide to do a "All in one" folder that you can download, unzip and add to your mods folder. You will just need to select the mods you want to change, that's not really difficult.

I'm working on the last mods that had request and i do a seasonal version of all the other mods, too (in my own playtrough, i love to store my seeds by seasons, soo... I want to help myself lol). I really don't know when this will be done, but i'm working on it little by little. See you soon guys!
[/b]
